name: Eric's Arc for Chrome
description: Arc features for Chrome's built-in tab bar.

close-tab.description: Close tab (locked tabs come back at their locked URL)

reset-tab.description: Reset pinned tab to its pinned URL

recent-next.description: Next recently used tab (Karabiner sends this for Ctrl+Tab)

recent-prev.description: Previous recently used tab (Karabiner sends this for Ctrl+Shift+Tab)

little-new.description: New Little Arc (set its scope to Global)

little-open-in.description: Little Arc: open in window or tab group…
